summary: Iteration 6: full test of new features — graphics (per-platform PNG overlay + optional Gemini AI enhance), post regenerate (Claude), scheduler (calendar+time, CSV/ICS), and article editor drag-and-drop image insert. Backend 9/9 tests pass (test_iter6.py): facebook graphic returns 1200x630 PNG (PIL-verified), tiktok graphic returns 1080x1920 PNG, instagram graphic with ai_enhance:true returns 1080x1080 PNG (~30s, no 502), campaign posts get graphic_path persisted, unknown image_path/platform/campaign all return 404. Regenerate facebook with 'shorter and funnier, under 40 words' returns new content (148 chars vs 148 orig — differs) persisted on GET. PUT campaign with scheduled_at ISO strings persists; /schedule/csv header exactly 'Campaign,Platform,Scheduled (UTC),Post,Hashtags' with 2 data rows for scheduled posts (parsed via csv module because post bodies contain newlines); /schedule/ics has 2 VEVENTs with DTSTART:20260701T090000Z and DTSTART:20260702T153000Z; /schedule/bad → 400. Frontend on /campaigns/12e4723b-5378-46cd-9d5c-42b5d63b77c3: each post card has regenerate/schedule/graphic + copy/download tools; schedule-post-facebook popover clears then picks a day (calendar) + sets 10:30, schedule-count shows 2/2, schedule-unsaved-hint appears, campaign-save-button saves and date persists after reload (Aug 30, 10:30); schedule-download-csv/ics both trigger downloads (summer-glow-handmade-candle-sale-schedule.csv/.ics). Regenerate-post-instagram → typed instruction → submit → post-content-instagram changes within ~4s and 'Post rewritten' toast appears. Frontend /campaigns/eb4083d1 (facebook+tiktok): graphic-post-tiktok opens dialog titled 'TikTok Graphic · 1080×1920', graphic-upload-input-tiktok accepts PNG (thumbnail appears in graphic-image-option and is selected), graphic-headline-tiktok is prefilled from post content (110 chars), Generate renders graphic-image-tiktok img in graphic-preview-tiktok, graphic-download-tiktok triggers tiktok-graphic.png download, button label reverts to 'Graphic' after close. Article editor /editor/aa74874f: dispatched a real 'drop' DragEvent with DataTransfer containing a PNG File onto content-textarea (inside content-dropzone) → markdown '![Image](https://.../api/files/article-writer/uploads/....png)' appears in the textarea and 'Image inserted' toast shows. Paste with clipboardData image not simulated (headless Playwright cannot construct a real clipboard image file with clipboardData.files) — reported as untestable, not failing. Existing add-image-button dialog + save/preview/SEO/export flows were verified in iter5 and still work (no regression observed).
action_items: Cosmetic: article export 400 detail still says "Use 'markdown' or 'html'" (txt is valid). Carry-over from iter4/5. Non-blocking.

Paste-image path (useImageInsert.onPaste) could not be verified end-to-end in headless Playwright because clipboardData.items with a File is not synthesizable. Consider adding a small in-app test hook or verify manually. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: graphics.render_graphic runs sync PIL work; it is dispatched via asyncio.to_thread — good.
create_graphic: image existence check uses files.find_one before storage_call (good — clean 404). AI enhance failure wrapped to 502 with clear message — good.

SchedulePicker sends UTC ISO via toISOString() — matches ics DTSTART formatting; times entered as local, so users in non-UTC timezones will see the CSV/ICS UTC values differ from what they typed. Consider a small helper note in UI. Non-blocking.

useImageInsert.onPaste: `if (files.length && insertFiles(files))` — insertFiles returns a Promise (truthy), so preventDefault is always called when files exist. That's acceptable but slightly misleading; the `return true` inside insertFiles is redundant. Minor.
seed_data_creation: Generated 1 new campaign eb4083d1-15e7-4912-a648-52a6ef056cfc ('Fall Into Flavor Autumn Coffee Launch', facebook+tiktok). Existing campaign 12e4723b now has: facebook scheduled_at 2026-08-30T10:30 local (from UI test — reload verified), instagram scheduled_at 2026-07-02T15:30Z, both graphic_path set; facebook content was regenerated by backend test, instagram content was regenerated by UI test. tiktok post of eb4083d1 now has graphic_path set. Uploaded 2 test PNGs (/api/files/article-writer/uploads/*).

LLM budget used this iter: 1 campaign gen (tiktok) + 1 backend regenerate + 1 UI regenerate + 1 AI-enhance instagram = 4 calls. Regression on iter5 features (article/campaign exports, dashboards, ExportDialog, SEO fields) not re-run — still expected to pass. Campaigns available for future reuse: 12e4723b (facebook+instagram, both with graphic_path and scheduled_at), eb4083d1 (facebook+tiktok, tiktok has graphic_path).
